ig.caption:
Nasdaq fair value gap, Friday 6 Nov. 2R to target.

A fair value gap is a 3-candle imbalance. Nasdaq left one, then came back to it.

The rule: let the gap form, wait for price to trade back into it, and keep the stop beyond the far side of the gap.
